description:
Your Definition SRAM

THE LATEST EVOLUTION OF OUR UNIQUE MASON DEFINITION, WITH CONFIGURABLE SRAM BUILD OPTIONS

Already unique, the definitive sporty, all season, AllRoad Definition, has evolved further. Previously described as 'A masterclass in bike design and engineering' and 'Phenomenal' by road.cc, the latest version is even more refined, optimised and detailed for fast, variable surface speed and travel.

The Definition is a game-changing bike, that excels in sportiness, all-season use, long-distance travel, AllRoad versatility, and performance. Sharing the overall geometry of our Columbus steel Resolution, it delivers a sportier feel while maintaining MASON's renowned long-distance comfort and dependability.

Crafted from premium Dedacciai aluminium, the frame ensures efficient pedalling and power transmission, featuring a low-weight, custom-shaped MASON x Dedacciai stays, and a large-diameter down tube for a responsive ride.

Since their launch, both the Resolution and Definition have been continually refined, staying true to their geometry and purpose, creating a category of their own. The Definition, optimised for long-distance and All-Season riding, has received updates without compromising its original magic.

Key changes in Definition 3.0 include revised hose and cable routing for modern components, dedicated dynamo cable routing ports for lighting systems, and optimised seat tube sizing across the range. Improved durability is achieved through uprated tubing treatment and accessory eyelets, ensuring resistance to harsh conditions.

Offering 8 frame size options (48cm to 62cm), our small bicycle company believes in providing a broad range for an optimised fit, essential for long-distance comfort and efficiency. The Definition continues to embody the same magical, refined, and dependable qualities that made it an all-year-round favourite since its debut in 2015.

Select From: SRAM Rival AXS / Force AXS / Red AXS, including 1x XPLR gearing options.

Full set of high-grade, stainless steel accessory mounting screws and small parts, including cable routing parts and MASON Multiport inserts, supplied with frameset.

Available with a choice of the best 700C tyres from Rene Herse, Schwalbe, Continental & Vittoria.

Available with a choice of HUNT, DT Swiss and Campagnolo wheelsets. Other options available on request.

Available with 'MASON Luminance Upgrade'. The ultimate dynamo + lighting set-up for all-terrain and multi-surface adventures. Select through Configurator.

Fully compatible with full-length mudguards. Choose from SKS 35mm or PDW FullMetalFender 37mm.

Optimised Seat Tube Sizing: Sizes 48 - 58cm use 31.8mm seat tube and 27.2mm seatpost. 60 & 62cm use oversize 34.9mm seat tubes and 31.6mm seatposts.

Carbon MASON Penta microadjust seatpost and MASON Macro seatclamp.

SRAM recommend Ø160mm front/rear. A Ø160mm up front is best if you are using cable braking. 160mm is the maximum recommended diameter for the rear.
